source.layout: FAT32 fixture extended sparsely to 4 GiB; 42 video entries and 2 photo entries

observations.streaming: 44 rows visible with carving at 0.0% and elapsed less than one second; no wait for scan completion.
observations.folderSelection: Selecting PHOTOS selected its two descendants. Filtering to PHOTOS retained both selections and showed existing/deleted record labels.
observations.preview: PHOTO001.JPG raster preview opened after scan cancellation and displayed PHOTOS/PHOTO001.JPG, existing status, fat-metadata method and complete-chain evidence.
observations.warnings: Two actual warnings described tentative paths in deleted directories with cleared allocation chains; these were separate from neutral scan information.
observations.layout: Location tree, result table, filters and preview panel inspected in native application; no overlapping controls observed.

limits: Synthetic image test, not a physical USB benchmark.
SHA-256 comparison verifies copied fixture bytes; it does not prove recoverability of arbitrary damaged originals.
Native QA exposed ETA sample/display-clock skew; subsequently fixed and covered by a focused unit test, not rechecked in this debug bundle.
